arStrings.szText: "Why do you want the Sightless Eye restored so badly?"
The Great Eye was bestowed to us by Philios the Firstborn and Lycander the angel. It allowed us to see fate without a great loss of youth and search for specific visions.
After it was stolen, our sight dimmed. Now the artifact does not heed us.
Frustrated that the Eye doesn't work for the oracles anymore.
Only the Eye can unlock my visions. Should I not give all to restore it back?
What are these visions of yours?
If only I knew myself. When I close my eyes, when I dream, I see fire. Eyes. A hunger unsated. But I cannot make sense of it. The Eye would show me all.
Dejected and tired at "If only I knew myself." When recounting parts of her vision, she emphasizes words.
I’ve spent my years naturally studying the oracles of old. The First Oracle documented the Great Eye first awakening. Here, read it for yourself.
Emphasis of "years naturally." Most oracles rapidly age themselves by using their magic. ATHRPA has refused to do that.
